request.style: English, Norwegian folk lullaby sung by an old woman with a soft cracked voice, a quiet Hardanger fiddle and a wooden langeleik drone, rocking slowly, 3/4, 60 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
There were shepherds out in the fields nearby
Keeping watch over their flock through the night
An angel of the Lord appeared to them
And the glory of the Lord shone around them

[Chorus]
Sleep now, little one, sleep now so softly
A baby wrapped in cloths
Sleep now, little one, sleep now so softly
A baby wrapped in cloths

[Verse]
Do not be afraid, the angel told them
I bring you good news of great joy
Today in the city of David a Savior is born to you
He is Christ the Lord

[Chorus]
Sleep now, little one, sleep now so softly
A baby wrapped in cloths
Sleep now, little one, sleep now so softly
A baby wrapped in cloths
